integrity: Originality concerns the labeled optimal-multiplicity formula and classification; the scalar corona Italian-domination number is previously known and credited to the earlier literature. Finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts only the minimum-weight coefficient for ordinary sunlets with n>=3, not the full polynomial or other corona families. Potential unindexed equivalent enumerations remain possible.
title: Exact minimum Italian-domination multiplicities of sunlet graphs
